phase: PASS-42 correction pass against the published round-1 revision -- twelve alleged defects adjudicated by independent verification and adversarial challenge; the nine that survived are corrected here, C4 is refuted and deliberately NOT edited, and the Data Availability Statement advances to v2.15 with every artifact that hardcodes the tag.
scientific_content_status: CORRECTED AND PUBLISHABLE. Pass-41 published the round-1 revision; pass-42 fixes what pass-41 shipped. The anchor defect was a Table A45 caption asserting that the tie counts confirm both identity controls while the table beneath it printed 2/25/2 for the D = 100 control. That caption is corrected to report the residual without asserting a cause. Contribution C3 is NOT narrowed: byte-stable determinism is claimed in the declared single-threaded environment, and a new regression at D >= 50 now demonstrates it in the tier the previous test never reached. No number, rank, p-value or decision changes in this pass; every edit is wording, plus the tag.
freeze_statement: Freeze for resubmission. Nine claims are discharged: the Table A45 caption (C1), the false self-audit that the population qualification is stated wherever the rank claims appear (C2), a stale universal falsified by the revision's own matched-population control (C3), the tier-threshold contradiction (C6), the over-broad robustness-variant scope (C7), the 'only fitness-affecting channel' exclusivity claim merged across two findings (C8+C9), a four-orders-of-magnitude overstatement that recomputes to two (C10), the transplant disclosure (C11), and the missing relativity warning on the matched-population ranks (C12). C4 is REFUTED and its proposed fix was rejected as a regression; it is deliberately not edited. Every FROM anchor was verified byte-exact and unique before application, per-file line endings were preserved, and every edit was verified in the built PDF and the DOCX rather than in the sources.
